entities.name: Roman Catholic Church in Șumuleu Ciuc
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Șumuleu Ciuc is a neighbourhood in the city of Miercurea Ciuc, Harghita County, Romania. Until 1959, it was a separate commune. It is the site of an annual Roman Catholic pilgrimage, when Catholics from all over Hungary, Slovakia and Romania gather there.
